module: Flowgraph node "im Number" (category repeat_instant, tag imgui): imgui number field. Mode chosen in the properties: Int, Float, SliderInt, SliderFloat, DragInt, DragFloat. Inputs: "text", "set" (pulse: reapplies setVal), "setVal" (0), "min" (0), "max" (10), "step" (1), "format" (%0.2f), "power" (1). Outputs: "value" and "changed" (pulse).
notes: The value is clamped to min/max even in free Int/Float mode.
Without an initial value (setVal nil), nothing is drawn.

_executionStarted.desc: Clears the outputs and the value.

work.desc: Draws the widget of the chosen mode, clamps the value and writes value/changed.
